messages:
Ravi (AE): Heads up, Beacon Labs wants to run a bakeoff: custom llama-30k tokenizer + hybrid 12b model variants (fp16 and q4f16). Need compatibility and security gating.
Tess (Solutions Eng): Key checks: tokenizer differences (30k vs our 50k default), embedding projection for mismatched dims, and whether q4f16 runtime supports llama-30k token ids.
Noah (SRE): For infra, q4f16 has tight memory alignment needs. On T4s it might OOM unless we use per-layer rematerialization. 12b fp16 should be fine on A10s.
Elena (Security): They require contract language around model provenance and an SRA. Also require KMS + audit logs and EU-only processing for their EU customers. Dedicated with BYOK likely.
Samir (Product): Add a note about model variant naming and cataloging: suggest customer pick a stable alias and provide checksums for each variant. Also advise a small canary with eval hooks.
Ravi (AE): Timeline: 2-week bakeoff, can we support hosted + dedicated trial?
Tess (Solutions Eng): Yes if artifacts arrive quickly. We'll do quick tokenizer parity tests in hosted sandbox and then break out to dedicated throughput runs.
Noah (SRE): I'll prepare an autoscale policy and memory tuning notes for q4f16. Also flag that we may require a custom quant shim if llama-30k uses nonstandard special tokens.
Elena (Security): I'll return a minimal info sheet for procurement and security: DPA, SOC2, KMS flow. Also request the model supply-chain attestation from Beacon Labs.
Samir (Product): I'll prepare an onboarding checklist and models.json snippet for their SREs.
Ravi (AE): Action items and ETAs: 1) @Tess tokenizer/compat note (ETA Thu) 2) @Elena security packet (ETA Wed) 3) @Noah infra tuning + lead time (ETA Thu) 4) @Samir product blurb + cost delta (ETA Fri).
Noah (SRE): Quick sample snippet for their ops team I'll share in follow-up:
```json
{
  "alias":"beacon-hybrid-12b",
  "variants":["beacon-12b:fp16","beacon-12b:q4f16"],
  "tokenizer":"llama-30k",
  "checksums":["sha256:abcd...","sha256:ef01..."]
}
```
Ravi (AE): Great. I'll loop procurement and set initial kickoff.
